canonical_claim: For an inclusion N subset M of type II_1 factors, the Jones index [M:N], when below 4, equals 4*cos(pi/n)^2 for some integer n >= 3; equivalently its finite real values lie in {4*cos(pi/n)^2 | n >= 3} union [4,infinity). Whether the execution target also asserts realization of every listed value remains open pending the primary-source crosswalk.
domain_and_universes: Open formal encoding: two type II_1 factors (or concrete von Neumann algebras on Hilbert spaces) with a unital inclusion, plus a source-faithful extended nonnegative-real Jones index.
quantifiers: for every source-admissible inclusion N subset M of type II_1 factors
if the index is below 4, there exists an integer n >= 3
hypotheses: N and M are type II_1 factors
N is included in M in the source-specified unital/normal sense
the index and any finiteness convention are those of the selected source
conclusion: The sub-4 index is 4*cos(pi/n)^2 for an integer n >= 3; the exact restriction-versus-realization boundary awaits source pinpointing.
excluded_degenerate_cases: Properness of the inclusion, equality N=M (index 1, corresponding to n=3), infinite index, reducible inclusions, non-factor von Neumann algebras, and whether all allowed values are realized must be decided from the primary theorem rather than guessed.
